ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  Bajaj Electricals Limited has filed a routine compliance certificate for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, affirming adherence to SEBI Regulation 74(5) concerning depositories and participants. The accompanying certificate from their Registrar and Transfer Agent confirms the proper and timely processing of all dematerialization requests, including the cancellation of physical shares and updating of the register of members. This filing indicates sound corporate governance in managing investor share-related activities, with no material impacts or red flags identified.
